navSub: Import a GPX and see its wind
title: Wind forecast for your Strava & Komoot routes
metaTitle: Wind forecast for Strava & Komoot routes – {name}
description: Import a route from Strava, Komoot or any GPX file and see headwind, tailwind and crosswind along it – at the time you will ride it.
intro: Your routes already live in Strava or Komoot. Bring them into {name} and see the wind on every kilometre – no redrawing, no guessing from a town forecast.
ctaLabel: Import a route in the web app

hero.mainAlt: Wind Flow Map of an imported route coloured by tailwind, crosswind and headwind
hero.overlayAlt: Tailwind Score of the imported route

howImageAlt: Tailwind Score with tailwind, crosswind and headwind shares of a route

how.title: Strava in one tap
how.text: Connect your Strava account once and pick any of your saved routes. With Premium, new routes arrive automatically every night.

how.title: Komoot and every other planner via GPX
how.text: Export a GPX file from Komoot, Garmin Connect or any route planner and drop it in – {name} reads the track and works out the wind along it.

how.title: Set start time and speed
how.text: Tell {name} when you start and how fast you ride. It calculates when you reach every point and uses the forecast for that moment.

ctaTitle: Bring your next route and see its wind.
